Claire M.: Heads-up: Meridian (clinical analytics) closed yesterday. 50 seats, Dedicated + VPC, 30d on-prem eval. They asked for per-token cost estimate and a conservative latency SLO for inference. Deal notes: https://paper.example/meridian-1122. Can CS pick this up?

Vikram S.: I'll own onboarding. Quick owners: onboarding/CS = Vikram S.; provisioning/infra = Zoe H.; support/runbook = Liam R.; finance = Finance-Bot.

Claire M.: Primary customer contact is Farah K. (Infra). They require SSO (Azure AD), Splunk logging, and a custom retention policy (7y archival). Also asked about quantization options to control costs.

Zoe H.: Platform asks: estimated steady qps and token distribution? Also need to know whether embeddings are used and where they should be stored. I'll open internal ticket rwinf/ops#1122.

Vikram S.: Expected baseline 35 r/s, spikes to 150 r/s for batch exports. Prompts avg 600 tokens; embeddings used for search, stored in customer-managed S3 during eval. Marking account health as "amber" until infra validated.

Liam R.: I'll draft the support runbook: SSO steps, Splunk HEC pattern, certs exchange for mTLS, and alert thresholds. Will create ticket ORG-MER-1122 in Zendesk and assign to Zoe.

Finance-Bot: Invoice request received: NET30. Renewal terms: 12mo auto-renew; flag renewal-watch at month 10. Finance owner: Priya (cc).

Zoe H.: Creating GH issue rwinf/ops#1122 and starting provisioning checklist. Needs: Azure AD SAML metadata, Splunk HEC token, S3 bucket ARN, and preferred quantization profile.

Vikram S.: I'll get SAML metadata from Farah and confirm S3 access. For quantization, propose 8-bit quantized Llama-family variant to balance latency/cost; flag for runtime review.

Claire M.: I'll ask sales to confirm cost cap request; Meridian mentioned a target 15% YoY cap — flag for finance review.

Liam R.: Tentative kickoff Wednesday 3pm PT. I'll include pre-read: onboarding checklist, support runbook draft, POC success criteria (latency < 300ms p50, recall > 0.88).

Vikram S.: Action items: Vikram - run kickoff & success criteria (owner: Vikram S.); Zoe - infra provisioning + GH issue (owner: Zoe H.); Liam - support runbook + Zendesk ticket (owner: Liam R.); Claire - sales follow-up on cost cap (owner: Claire M.).

Claire M.: Thanks team. Will loop back after I confirm SAML and the cost cap language. :thumbsup:
